2. The Coasting and Passenger Manifests required
for all domestic vessels shall be reduced to
three (3) copies, instead of seven (7), and
shall henceforth be submitted to the PPA.
agencies concerned requiring copies of said
manifests for their own use shall secure the
same from PPA.
3. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of December
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred ninety-one.
By the President:
Executive Secretary
